crossRefs.note: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
“He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their…
Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.
They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they…
Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are…
But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the…
There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen.…
“You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you…
because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

translations.web: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
translations.bsb: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
translations.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
translations.asv: Why do ye not understand my speech? Even because ye cannot hear my word.
